question: Under whom was CP Ilbert a law member of the council?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Ripon.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **CP Ilbert** was a **law member of the council** under** Lord Ripon.**
 
• Lord Ripon was the **Viceroy of India** from **1880 to 1884.**<
